items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Terminology 33:1
items.html: (To the question) What is the last Hod? It is known that the essence of ZA is only six vessels, which are KHB HGT, and at the time that he attains Mochin, new NHY come out for him. And these vessels of KHB HGT are discerned only as HGT NHY in relation to the lights, as is known. And therefore, at the time that the new NHY come to him, it is discerned that the HGT became KHB, and the old NHY became HGT, and the new NHY serve him now as NHY, as is known. And there is a discernment here between the Mochin of the Neshama of ZA and the Mochin of his Chaya. For the Mochin of the Neshama are discerned for ZA only as the aspect of his VAK of the greatness, because he needs to reach the GAR of Aba and Ima of Shabbat Musaf. And therefore the Mochin of the Neshama are like VAK to him, which are the HGT NHY of the greatness. And therefore it is discerned that the HGT of the greatness clothe in the vessels of KHB, and the NHY of the greatness clothe in the vessels of HGT, and the new NHY remain still without light. And it is found that the lights did not spread in him except only up to “the first Hod”, namely the Hod that has now become Gevura, but “the last Hod” remains still empty of light, for the lights did not reach the new NHY of ZA, as above. And know that the Hod of the old NHY, which became HGT, is called the first Hod, and the Hod of the new NHY is called the last Hod. (Item 40).
